description: Gares desservies par le TGV en France is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cyril Gervais. Gares desservies par le TGV en France Description Localisation des 182 gares desservies par les trains à grande vitesse (TGV inOui, Ouigo, TERGV, TGV Lyria, Eurostar, ICE, AVE, Frecciarossa) en France métropolitaine à partir de la page Wikipédia (extraction décembre 2025) et l'API SNCF (pour les coordonnées géographiques). Coverage: Cyril Gervais. The publisher named on the listing is Cyril Gervais. Its keywords include train, transport, transport-en-commun, tgvinoui, sncf, gare-de-voyageurs. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GPKG, CSV. The listing shows 2026-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
